concepts.definition: ODD is the graph-native product-authoring method for GTL/ABG domain products. Its structural carriers are typed domain assets, named graph functions, a published function catalog, an operative GTL module, ABG-owned execution, a constructive evaluation loop, and current-state projections over constructive history.

grounding.quote: ODD method is the graph-native product-authoring method for building GTL/ABG domain products.

concepts.label: ODD method

conditions: Applies to every ODD product over GTL/ABG.
concepts.definition: The method-level homeostasis loop connects intent lineage and model synthesis, observation, gap pressure, exact target binding, lawful action selection, admitted construction and evidence, fulfillment and closure, and subsequent lawful action.

grounding.quote:
Every ODD product over GTL/ABG must preserve one constructive evaluation loop
from intent lineage and model synthesis through observation to next lawful
action.

concepts.label: Constructive evaluation loop

concepts.definition: The selected Product outcome under STDO-UP-013 is external authority for the loop. An admitted bounded prerequisite or experiment may also supply a bounded work basis. Models, gaps, assurance, ledgers and projections interpret these bases but do not author, select or enlarge the outcome.

grounding.quote:
The selected Product outcome under `STDO-UP-013` is external authority for this
loop. Product models, gaps, assurance, ledgers, and projections may interpret
that outcome but cannot author, select, or enlarge it.

concepts.label: Selected Product outcome and bounded bases

concepts.definition: IntentLineage is admitted source intent with human, imported-source, prior-product, intent-engine or prior synthesized-intent lineage, held as ABG event-log truth. ProductAssetModel is desired and known typed asset truth synthesized from lineage, prior model and admitted product truth, with admitted publication events and product projection references; it is neither runtime fact nor action authority. Worksite is observable workspace, runtime archive, transform assets, product asset root, profile and file/process state. RuntimeEventLog is append-only admitted runtime facts; RuntimeProjection is replay-derived current runtime state over that log and execution basis. ObservationSnapshot is a read-only runtime/worksite view carried by the ABG evaluator with product domain rows. GapPressureRow describes missing, partial, blocked, waiting or ambiguous asset/evidence pressure relative to the model.

grounding.quote: | `ObservationSnapshot` | Read-only view of runtime truth plus worksite facts relevant to construction. | ABG evaluator carrier with product domain rows. |

concepts.label: Intent, model, runtime and observation carriers

concepts.definition: TargetObligationBinding exactly binds gap pressure to the selected Product outcome, any admitted prerequisite/experiment basis, target assets, required roles, evidence references and admissible graph outcomes. ActionCatalog publishes lawful graph functions, vectors, targets, inputs and eligible outcomes. PriorityProjection deterministically ranks bound lawful actions under visible policy. ConstructionIntent is an admitted selected action for one bounded graph invocation preserving outcome/bounded-basis references. NextActionProjection reads NextActionBasis and current truth to select a next graph action only when lawful. These are product domain bindings and policy over GTL/ABG publication, admission and traversal authority.

grounding.quote: | `TargetObligationBinding` | Exact binding from gap pressure to the selected Product outcome, any admitted prerequisite or experiment basis, target assets, required roles, evidence refs, and admissible graph outcomes. | Product domain binding over GTL/ABG action authority. |

concepts.label: Binding, catalog, intent and action projections

concepts.definition: AdmittedEvidence comprises admitted worker, process, product, execution, materialization, liveness and postflight evidence, not worker self-closure. EdgeFulfillmentLedger carries closure evidence and convergence for one edge attempt/version, including counts, obligation rows, materialization/liveness/admission references and edge_converged. EdgeClosureDecision is the sum type close, yield, retry, repair, re-enter, reprice or block. NextActionBasis is the dispatch sum initial_selection, post_yield_resume, post_close_graph_continuation, post_retry, post_repair, post_reenter, post_reprice or post_block; it is not another controller, and post_reprice carries no action-selection authority.

concepts.definition: Finite actors have bounded context, attention, time and capability. An activated frame combines a declared evaluation family, exact workspace/topology basis, finite material relations/coordinates, applicable invariants/authorities, admissible evidence/exclusions and actor envelope. Its evaluated predicates use satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame or invalid_basis. Project engagement proceeds through human-informed frame-set declaration, bounded evaluations, required conjunction/translation, coverage with residual uncertainty, and empirical revision; these remain separate functions. An atomic engagement unit can contain multiple semantic atoms and owner relations.

grounding.quote:
`Atomic engagement unit` names the unit that can be activated and evaluated as
one bounded context. It does not assert that every relation inside the frame is
one irreducible semantic atom.

concepts.label: Bounded frame engagement and result domain

concepts.definition: An evaluation is a declared question with known predicate, admissible evidence, decision authority and, for material action, operation authority. Questions may concern judgment, prediction, construction, comparison, proof, refusal, classification or action recommendation. An evaluation family groups questions requiring the same material-relation manifold, authority basis and core-result binding/refinement; similar wording does not establish family identity.

grounding.quote:
An evaluation family groups questions that require the same material relation
manifold, authority basis, and result binding or refinement of that one algebra.
Similar wording does not prove that two evaluations belong to the same family.

concepts.label: Evaluation and evaluation family

concepts.definition: Workspace is the bounded material body reasoned over or acted upon, potentially including constitutional sources, domain assets, designs, implementations, tools, runtime state, evidence, history, external dependencies and human decisions. It is broader than a repository and distinct from an actor's acquired view.

grounding.quote:
The workspace is broader than a repository. A repository is one possible
carrier.

concepts.label: Frame workspace

concepts.definition: Basis identifies the exact evaluation state, including every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration or evidence coordinate whose change can alter the evaluation. It may be immutable or moving.

grounding.quote:
A **basis** identifies the exact state against which an evaluation is made. It
includes every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration, or
evidence coordinate whose change can alter the evaluation.

concepts.label: Evaluation basis

conditions: Materiality is relative to the evaluation; a relation may be irrelevant in another frame.
concepts.definition: A relation is material when a lawful change can change the evaluation result, invalidate its basis, change admissible evidence, or change who may perform a material operation or decide it.

grounding.quote:
A relation is **material** to an evaluation when a lawful change to that
relation can change the evaluation result, invalidate its basis, change the
admissible evidence, change who may perform a material operation, or change who
may decide it.

concepts.label: Evaluation-relative material relation

concepts.definition: The material-relation manifold is the finite jointly interpretable set of variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities, observations and exclusions needed for an evaluation family. It is a bounded relation space with potentially overlapping coordinate charts; geometric mathematics and runtime manifold abstractions are not required.

grounding.quote:
The **material-relation manifold** is the finite, jointly interpretable set of
variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities,
observations, and exclusions needed for an evaluation family.

concepts.label: Material-relation manifold

concepts.definition: A coordinate is the complete local interpretation position of a value, event, decision, observation or action, including required basis, identity, lineage, input, evidence and authority. Coordinate equality follows a declared relation, not equal names, values, shapes, locations or apparent topology positions.

grounding.quote:
Equal names, values, shapes, locations, or apparent topology positions do not
establish coordinate equality. Equality follows a declared relation.

concepts.label: Coordinate and declared equality

concepts.definition: Topology is the structure among material entities, capabilities, authorities, lifecycle state spaces, adjacencies and seams visible to a frame at one basis; it need not be the workspace's complete topology. A state-value change preserves topology only if every such material element/relation is preserved; changing any is a topology mutation that may invalidate coordinates.

grounding.quote:
A state-value change preserves the frame topology only when it preserves every
material entity, relation, lifecycle, authority, capability, adjacency, and
seam.

concepts.label: Frame topology

concepts.definition: Evidence is an exact admitted observation/artifact with provenance, subject identity, basis and scope. Presence in a frame alone makes it neither semantic truth nor decision authority. Assertion provenance justifies the expected predicate; execution provenance identifies the acquired subject and result.

grounding.quote:
**Evidence** is the exact observation or artifact admitted for an evaluation.
Evidence carries provenance, subject identity, basis, and scope. Evidence does
not become semantic truth or decision authority merely because it is available
inside a frame.

concepts.label: Frame evidence

concepts.definition: Frame authority vocabulary distinguishes human frame-set declaration/acceptance authority; semantic ownership of meaning; evaluation authority to evaluate; owner-issued operation grants to construct, transform, admit, publish or mutate; decision authority to accept, reject or dispose; and the human, agent, tool or process actor identity.

grounding.quote:
- **semantic authority**: the owner of meaning for a material relation;
- **evaluation authority**: the role permitted to perform an evaluation;

concepts.label: Distinct frame authority relations

concepts.definition: Frame disjointness means no shared material variable, coordinate, evidence or result dependency for the declared evaluations. Evaluation independence means separate activations do not consume/influence each other's unclosed working results, despite possible shared subjects/manifolds and later closed-result conjunction. Assurance independence is claim-relative separation of non-authorship, evidence acquisition, reference exposure, actors and configuration under the governing assurance law. None follows from the unqualified word independent; disjointness and independent activation do not imply one another.

grounding.quote:
Disjoint frames need not be independently evaluated, and independently
activated evaluations need not be disjoint. The unqualified word
`independent` does not establish any of these relations by itself.

concepts.label: Disjointness, evaluation independence and assurance independence

concepts.definition: A capability envelope declares competence, context capacity, tools, access, applicable evaluation/assurance independence and configuration needed for frame activation and evaluation. Usability is actor-relative.

grounding.quote:
A **capability envelope** declares the competence, context capacity, tools,
access, applicable evaluation- or assurance-independence conditions, and
configuration required to activate a frame and perform its evaluations.

concepts.label: Actor capability envelope

concepts.definition: A reference frame is a finite evaluation contract specifying attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations for one declared family at a stated basis. Its optional formal description is F = <Q,B,M,C,I,A,E,X,R,J,K,D>: evaluation family; workspace/topology basis; material manifold; coordinate/equality law; invariants; authority; evidence/provenance; exclusions/prohibited assumptions; core results/refinements; invalidation/recharting; actor envelope; optional inter-frame dependencies, overlaps, inputs and outputs. This tuple is not a required schema/runtime carrier. Prompts, packets and symbolic programs project activated frames; they are not the frame itself.

grounding.quote:
A frame is bound when every material
coordinate above resolves to an exact source, subject, basis, authority,
evidence route, actor envelope, result relation, and invalidation condition.

concepts.label: Reference frame

concepts.definition: An activated frame binds a declaration to an exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary. A reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct.

grounding.quote:
An **activated frame** binds one frame declaration to an exact evaluation,
workspace subject, basis, actor, and evidence acquisition boundary. A reusable
frame declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct.

concepts.label: Activated frame

concepts.definition: A frame set is a human-declared family available for a governed outcome/workspace. It may contain intentional overlaps, alternatives, specialist frames, broad exploratory frames and separately activated assurance frames; it need not be a partition, tree, stack or exhaustive ontology.

grounding.quote:
A **frame set** is the human-declared family of frames available for a governed
outcome or workspace.

concepts.label: Frame set

concepts.definition: An active frame configuration is the activations and declared result relations used for one evaluation/decision. It may have one or several disjoint, overlapping or composed frames; separate activations may overlap or be disjoint.

grounding.quote:
An **active frame configuration** is the set of frame activations and declared
result relations used for one evaluation or decision.

concepts.label: Active frame configuration

concepts.definition: A lens is a reusable question family across a frame configuration, such as authority, capability/reuse, time, transport or proof. It becomes a frame only through bounded evaluation, basis, manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra and capability-envelope instantiation.

grounding.quote:
A lens becomes a frame only when it is instantiated with a bounded evaluation,
basis, material manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra, and capability
envelope.

concepts.label: Lens

concepts.definition: A role allocates responsibility/authority; a persona alters approach/salience; an abstraction hides/contracts detail; a component is a structural subject part. Each can help construct/activate a frame but none is a frame by identity alone. A component can occur in several frames and a frame can cross several components.

grounding.quote:
A **role** allocates responsibility or authority. A **persona** alters an
actor's approach or salience. An **abstraction** hides or contracts detail. A
**component** is a structural part of a subject.

concepts.label: Role, persona, abstraction and component

These signatures describe method relations. They do not require callable
software interfaces.

concepts.label: Frame method functions

concepts.definition: Joint use distinguishes independently activated co-evaluation, result conjunction, evidence/coordinate translation and material composition.

grounding.quote: Frames participate together through four distinct relations.

concepts.label: Four forms of joint frame use

concepts.definition: Declared frame relations may be disjoint; overlapping; complementary evaluations informing one decision; alternative evaluations of a claim under stated capability/evidence conditions; refinement resolving an aggregated distinction; lawful domain restriction; translation through a declared coordinate map; temporal succession on a changed basis; composition into one governed evaluation/action; or governing/subordinate constraint inheritance where a real authority/decomposition relation exists. This separates
three claims: the inventory covers the selected scope, every applicable slot
has admissible support, and the supported results establish the governed
predicate.

grounding.quote: Coverage(W, G, B, E, S, T)

It draws from every material available source, including applicable intent/Product/requirements/method; design/Ontology/identity/lifecycle/authority/algorithms; capabilities and external behavior; operational/release/security/safety/governance duties; direct/indirect dependencies and seams; tests/scenarios/qualification/acceptance; tickets/check-ins/commentary/postmortems/incidents/rejections; long loops/resets/repairs/rival paths; actor limits/invisible violations; and external law/contracts/standards.

grounding.quote:
The coverage evaluator derives the known evaluation inventory from every
material available source, including where applicable:

concepts.label: Known evaluation inventory

concepts.definition: Typical cross-cutting coverage lenses are outcome/capability, identity/authority, lifecycle/time, topology/seams, transport/representation, evidence/proof, change/failure/recovery/rollback, historical regression and actor/context fit. These examples become frames only when separately instantiated as bounded evaluation families.

grounding.quote:
These are coverage lenses. They become frames only when separately instantiated
as bounded evaluation families.

concepts.label: Coverage dimensions

constraints.statement: The four contracts and constitutional equation form one traversal-consequence surface. Contract application binds declared inputs, output predicate and authority; composition preserves causal lineage through admitted closure to next action. Rival traversal paths fail the authority condition even if artifacts match. The equation projects lineage, synthesizes M0, observes G0, binds outcome/bounded basis U to B0, evaluates initial selection N0, separately admits intent, invokes and admits evidence, evaluates action A, resynthesizes M1, freshly observes G1, rebinds B1, derives Q1 from A.decision and evaluates N1. U must remain reachable through binding and intent. The post_reprice case without separately admitted constitutional basis yields typed no-action pending re-entry.
constraints.uncertainty: The equation is interpreted as source-defined computational structure, not executed.

grounding.quote: Every closure-relevant F_P callout that does work needs ledger admission.

constraints.statement: Worksite files, process/screen output, worker artifacts and product files are observations, becoming authority only through typed evidence admission and ledger/decision folding. F_P acts in W; admission records L; E orders/anchors entries with predecessor refs; Ev evaluates a declared L snapshot, and its F_P output must enter L/E before affecting closure, routing or traversal. W may change without contract satisfaction; L may contain true admitted claims without being all W. Closure/evaluation use W through L. Corrections append/supersede rather than rewrite history. L cannot overrule contrary current W observations: the admission owner admits supported observation and currentness uncertainty before dependent closure/selection. While interpretation is unresolved, affected claims are not current support; recording observation gives no verdict, admitted interpretation invalidates via declared re-entry, and missing admission gives no currentness proof. Historical admission remains true to its stated basis.

grounding.quote:
An evaluator may attend only to admitted ledger rows reachable through declared
lineage, predecessor refs, target binding, policy, and the relevant event-log
cursor.

constraints.statement: Evaluator attention is restricted to admitted rows reachable through lineage, predecessor references, target binding, policy and relevant log cursor. Workspace facts, worker prose, archives, summaries or controller memory outside that set are excluded. Lineage determines allowed evidence, exclusions and reproducible predecessor chains; ledger attention is typed, immutable, lineage-constrained, policy-bounded and replayable.

conditions: For every constructive action before invocation.

grounding.quote:
A broad edge cannot satisfy a specific product or evidence gap unless the
binding proves that edge is the lawful action for those exact assets.

constraints.statement: Bind current gap to exact targets and obligations using selected outcome ref, optional admitted prerequisite/experiment ref, pressure, assets, required roles and evidence refs. A broad edge is eligible only if this binding proves lawfulness for the exact assets. evaluate_next ranks only published lawful catalog actions. An unpublished desired action requires typed no-action, never fallback to a broad executive graph or local script.

grounding.quote: `evaluate_next` must be total.

constraints.statement: initial_selection uses current model/gap/binding/catalog/policy. post_yield_resume resumes or yields the same edge from replay-visible truth without adding failure classification. post_close_graph_continuation may select a next edge after closure or no action when complete. For post_retry, post_repair, post_reenter and post_block, first select any higher-priority lawful action; otherwise follow the current edge if still lawful; otherwise reprice/block if authority is missing; otherwise block with typed no-action. Unresolved post_reprice must return typed no-action; replacement work needs separately admitted exact outcome/bounded basis via new initial_selection or basis-bearing resume. Default graph following remains an evaluate_next decision, not hidden sequential control.

grounding.quote:
A true projection requires satisfied closure. A false/open projection retains
the failed or unresolved result and its reason, rather than treating every
open edge as falsified.

constraints.statement: Raw artifact presence, worker report, process success or CLI summary cannot close an edge. Closure folds AdmittedEvidence through EdgeFulfillmentLedger to EdgeClosureDecision. evaluate_action applies contract application to admitted-evidence reliance for the predicate and required evidence fixed by pre-action binding, then core conjunction over those exact obligations. Admissible reliance is not fitness, and post-action target reduction cannot replace the predicate. Retain original domain assessments; ledger/decision support closure disposition only. edge_converged represents the complete predicate, never counts, liveness or artifacts alone; true requires satisfied closure, false/open retains actual failure or unresolved reason. Only evaluate_next selects subsequent work from decision and fresh gap truth.

grounding.quote:
A lawful decision
can be `satisfied` while the edge's fitness remains falsified or unresolved.

constraints.statement: Every disposition is replay-visible with reproducible basis/reason refs. Dispositions refine rather than replace core verdicts. The decision predicate is lawful issuance for the subject/current basis/mandate; satisfaction requires F_D/ABG/product admission, not an unadmitted evaluator proposal. close requires satisfied complete closure. Demonstrated obligation violation remains falsified under any other disposition, including yield. Undecided closure is indeterminate only absent deciding falsification, invalid basis or out-of-frame conjunction result. Unusable basis is invalid_basis; outside admitted action domain is out_of_frame. Unperformed evaluation is not_performed; worker non-start is a separate work/effect fact, not non-performance of an evaluation that ran. Unknown evaluation performance is unconfirmed. Preserve independent counterevidence/diagnoses and legal core pairs. Each predicate retains its verdict, evidence, performance, effects and domain output. No-action may satisfy lawful selection without completing the Product. Both decision predicates require authority/contract evidence; established violations falsify, undecided mandate/support is indeterminate, and governing-interpretation or scope/capability diagnoses remain invalid_basis/out_of_frame.
constraints.uncertainty: Full core legal pairs and conjunction rules are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote: Disposition is conceptual; selection is invocational.

constraints.statement: yield is lawful iteration when the same edge/attempt remains lawful, admitted progress/waiting and replay-visible resume basis exist, and no new failure classification is added; retained assessments survive. Yield is neither retry, block, timeout nor local CLI loop and returns control without losing the current edge. Liveness observes activity, inactivity, process state and interruption; alone it can support yield/interruption but not semantic failure, closure or requirement non-satisfaction. evaluate_action may emit repair/re-enter; evaluate_next selects their published graph realization from admitted closure and action authority, not local string-based retry branches.

grounding.quote:
A broken predecessor
chain is non-replayable at the carrier level and therefore fails A13.

constraints.statement: Every closure/next-action decision must reproduce from event log, execution basis, log-backed lineage, model publication basis/events, outcome/bounded refs, gap, binding, catalog, admitted evidence, ledger, closure decision, next-action basis and visible policy. Failure to reproduce is hidden state. Governing admitted/replay carriers must carry causal predecessor refs without external joins: lineage→model→gap→binding→priority→selected-action projection→intent→evidence→ledger→closure→basis→next projection, with outcome/bounded refs reaching binding. Both action projections retain their own predecessors; the latter uses fresh gap truth. Recovery uses current workspace/contract application and sufficient reachable ledger with current basis/invalidators, not necessarily all history or repeated still-valid evaluation. Resolve material unknown/partial effects before dependent repetition; a lost response proves neither not_started nor completed.

conditions: When an outer vector is refined into published inner graph vectors.
exceptions: Intentionally opaque internal realization may use local computation within one bounded action, subject to the stated traversal prohibition.

grounding.quote:
Once a refinement is
published as graph structure, it is governed by the loop recursively.

constraints.statement: Each published inner boundary obeys all four functions with its own visible model, gap, binding, action, evidence, ledger, closure and next projection. Opaque internal control must not publish, dispatch, retry, repair, re-enter or close graph work as a hidden controller. ABG owns runtime truth, replay, graph-call lifecycle, actor/process supervision, continuation and re-entry mechanics. Product owns asset/catalog meaning, gap interpretation and priority policy. Design Module Method governs realization inside that split without creating module-local eval_gap/evaluate_next/evaluate_action authorities.

conditions: For tickets, designs, code modules or proofs touching any four-function, traversal, gap, selection, intent, invocation, evidence-admission, fulfillment, liveness, closure, re-entry, query or live-proof surface.
exceptions: Unchanged accepted relations cite their accepted basis rather than being re-proven.

grounding.quote: historical admission does not prove present conformance.

constraints.statement: Causally applicable axioms and equation control acceptance for the selected outcome/affected boundary without authorizing horizontal growth, new Product work or outcome expansion. Local checklists, tests, grep, CLI summaries or notes cannot weaken them. A rival consequence path prevents constitutional completion despite local completion; lawful treatments are re-entry request, retained closure blocker or separately bounded paydown under an independently selected outcome/prerequisite. Gap dossiers, postflight/assurance reports, manifests, liveness projections, run summaries, worker prose, screen/PTY transcripts, prompts, harness target arguments, grep tests, CLI branches/output, queries and service output provide evidence/diagnostics/read context only, never independent closure, action selection or retry/repair/re-entry routing. In conflict, the admitted ledger/decision/projection chain governs, with contrary current observations still requiring re-observation/admission. An absent chain establishes neither constitutional closure nor selection.

grounding.quote: ODD method gives the product shape, not the domain semantics.

constraints.statement: The same ODD structural law can build different domain products. Each product defines its asset meanings, proof lanes and query overlays; structural GTL law and product-specific semantic law remain distinct.

grounding.quote: If the team cannot explain the manual traversal, the automation is not yet method-safe. If automation cannot be explained in these terms, it is ahead of the method.

constraints.statement: Automation must remain true for manual walkthrough. A human should be able to perform the described steps using only declared authority. Automation can speed, safeguard or repeat the process but cannot invent a different one. It is unlawful to skip undeclared nodes, fabricate authority, collapse constitutional transitions opaquely without declared refinement, depend on private implementation-carrier knowledge unavailable to the installed product, or merge installed-builder and under-development Product authority in self-host work.

grounding.quote: A passed admission and a completed walkthrough are conformance evidence, not ratification.

constraints.statement: The real-work walkthrough follows intake triage, smallest lawful re-entry, spec/requirement/design/ticket chain, constructive loop and closure proof using declared surfaces. The packet includes input/output contract, required context, role, evaluator regime and provenance, but only smallest sufficient authority with refs; memory/hidden wholesale context cannot replace it, and compression is input rather than deciding authority. Produced work must have correct change-class, traceability and admission. Deterministic, fail-closed admission under SPEC_METHOD/TICKET_METHOD gates tickets, classifications, module derivations and execution contracts and names violated rules; drafted classification is not automatic truth. Walkthrough proof is independent of runtime availability; external API/transport dependent live execution cannot by itself prove process soundness. Passed admission/walkthrough do not ratify shared change or constitutionalize repeated grey work.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed admission and shared-change rules reside in unsupplied owner sections.

grounding.quote:
`method defect` and `agent error` are causal findings with provenance,
not verdict aliases.

constraints.statement: Inability to proceed is a method defect only when a competent correctly configured agent using declared authority cannot decide because of ambiguity, missing step, contradictory authority or undecidable owning change-class; route that defect to its owner for repricing. Ignored authority, stale memory or bad reasoning is agent error, not by itself method-defect evidence. Admission rejects demonstrated malformed artifacts either way. Method adequacy assesses whether named clauses provide a decidable required step for that actor/packet: demonstrated preventing defect falsifies; demonstrated decidability satisfies; undecided cause/insufficient evidence is indeterminate; unusable basis/out-of-scope evaluation keeps core diagnosis. Agent error alone does not satisfy adequacy and artifact refusal alone does not falsify it. Retain separate assessments, performance, effects and causal provenance.

grounding.quote:
It must not manufacture the refusal state, blocked
event, gap, or verdict that the system is supposed to derive.

constraints.statement: Negative proof must derive rather than manufacture refusal, blocked event, gap or verdict. It identifies supported entry/authority, invalidates the real input, exercises the path, proves refusal before prohibited effect and that no legacy, fallback, reconstruction or parallel path succeeds. Source, packaged, installed and runtime absence are distinct claims. No CLI, SDK, service, adapter, plugin, fixture, query or projection may become a rival traversal controller. Consumer owns concrete test/evidence mechanism; this section owns its required property.

conditions: For graph-function composition and each consuming function's material required bindings.

grounding.quote: Each retained `GraphFunction` should declare:

constraints.statement: Composition uses a cumulative typed environment, not merely last-output-to-next-input. Each retained GraphFunction should declare environment.requires, environment.provides and environment.carries. Later functions may require any available cumulative typed binding. Apply Composition law at the consumer to every material binding, including those carried through intermediates. Presence alone does not establish currentness, compatible basis or operation authority. Publishing graph functions without cumulative-environment law is structurally wrong.
constraints.uncertainty: The declaration wording is a recommendation; cumulative-environment law is mandatory. Full Composition law is not supplied.

conditions: When an outer public carrier is refined into inner executable structure; for current Product closure.
exceptions: A requirement may be excluded from the active obligation set through supported authorized deferral or repricing, without being realized.

grounding.quote:
Unknown applicability cannot remove required
coverage.

constraints.statement: Local green arcs are insufficient: inner chain must close lawfully, coarse contract remain true after fold-back, and zoomed/unzoomed views agree on outer open/closed state. Live current requirements without executable proof keep the carrier open until realized, explicitly deferred or explicitly repriced out. Retain original assessment and owning exclusion support; changed obligations do not prove original realization. Conjoin all still-applicable obligations and joins; closed requires satisfied conjunction plus owning closure decision, while open retains actual falsified/indeterminate/diagnosed result. Witness must be a governed realized proof surface appropriate to requirement class; testcase/archive evidence is usual for active software, not universal.

grounding.quote: A scenario bundle should make clear:

constraints.statement: A scenario bundle should identify feature/use-case boundary, expected starting assets, expected vectors, significant exercised paths and closing evidence. Declared scenarios/use cases guide selection of significant code/control paths that the system must exercise.

conditions: Where the Product has an installable development form.

grounding.quote: Where the product has an installable development form, decisive proof runs against that installed development form in an isolated environment.

constraints.statement: Decisive proof uses installed development form in isolation. For graph-native ODD, the lane should exercise install, project bootstrap, traversal, evidence collection and target-relative closure in that order. Useful direct source checks do not replace installed-dev proof.

grounding.quote:
Where the product provides ODD framework behavior, it must build that behavior
through ODD graph functions.

constraints.statement: The Product should develop through its claimed graph-native method and increasingly describe/build itself through explicit assets, vectors, graph functions, scenarios and target-relative closure. Where it provides ODD framework behavior, it must build that behavior through ODD graph functions and must not add ODD-shaped artifacts after imperative execution has decided the work. Self-walkability is described as strengthening the method.

grounding.quote: Release version is not constitutional graph truth.

constraints.statement: Release version belongs to release process/metadata. Graph-native method concerns current assets, vectors, closures and authority. Immutable RC publication, version-line selector advancement and exact-cut acceptance remain a separate process surface.

conditions: When assessing ODD conformance for a claimed capability and published boundary.

grounding.quote:
they select
deciding owners rather than define another checklist law.

constraints.statement: Apply contract application to capability, boundary and causally applicable loop contracts. Route missing nodes/vectors/outer contracts/carriers to Graph Model, Typed Assets, Graph Functions, Outcome-First and GTL Module; imperative-first/hidden execution to Outcome-First, ABG Continuation, Execution Audit and A0; unlawful walkthrough/ungated artifacts to manual/agentic conformance; private target knowledge or merged self-host authority to Product/Self-Host boundaries and Installed-Dev; missing scenario paths/evidence to Scenario, A6 and negative proof; last-output composition/scale conflict to Cumulative Environment, Global Convergence and A14; flattened yield to A4/A8/A9/A10; output-decided work to Projection-Source Coherence and A4a/A7/A11/A12/A16. Failure blocks its corresponding owner-bound claim. Unperformed/inconclusive proof retains its applicable core result; grep or inventory cannot substitute for the authority-path claim.
constraints.uncertainty: Several deciding owners are outside the supplied source.

conditions: When the represented instruction is to build a Product using ODD_METHOD.
exceptions: Read a product-specific method only if one exists.

grounding.quote: 14. only then implement code, policy, and transport surfaces

constraints.statement: Expected order: read SPEC_METHOD preserving constitutional chain; product-specific method if present; local INTENT, PRODUCT, relevant requirements and active design; identify source-to-outcome semantic chain, typed assets/nodes and public graph carriers; define machine-readable catalog; define/update GTL module with outer callable/live boundaries; define coarse/inner/proof closure coherence; complete affected execution-authority audit for runtime/plugin/worker/event/projection/assurance/closure/continuation; define full constructive loop; define closure vocabulary with yield distinct from retry/block/timeout/local waiting; define query projection over admitted history with source coherence; only then implement code, policy and transport. Imperative scripts with later GTL labels, documentary graph wrappers or hidden service carriers do not satisfy this invocation.
constraints.uncertainty: This is interpretation of a source-defined sequence, not an instruction executed here.

1. `SPEC_METHOD.md`
2. `ODD_METHOD.md`
3. the product's `stdo_<label>.json` definition

constraints.statement: Read in order: SPEC_METHOD; ODD_METHOD; Product stdo_<label>.json; applicable bound project frame basis and authorized activation packet; bound Intent; bound Product definition; relevant bound requirements; active bound designs; GTL module, function catalog and query surfaces.
constraints.uncertainty: Concrete Product bindings and referenced documents are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
- `ODD_METHOD.md` sets the structural expectation
- the product-specific method sets the domain law
- the local product surfaces set the current build line

constraints.statement: Read in order: SPEC_METHOD, ODD_METHOD, WORLD_MODEL_METHOD, Product stdo_<label>.json, applicable bound project frame basis/authorized activation packet, bound Intent, bound Product, relevant bound requirement families, current bound designs, then GTL module/catalog/query/proof lane. ODD supplies structure, product method domain law and local surfaces current build line. Skipping ordering is described as usually missing the domain despite paradigm understanding, or using a wrong carrier despite domain understanding.
constraints.uncertainty: Concrete Product bindings and WORLD_MODEL_METHOD are not supplied.

conditions: For a cold actor's ODD entry acquisition claim.

grounding.quote:
An unanswered required relation means the product
is not yet sufficiently specified for that ODD entry; a glossary or generic
rule packet cannot supply the actual subject.

constraints.statement: The actor should readily recover semantic chain, assets/nodes, public functions/catalog/GTL, ABG/Product split and exact loop/dispositions/proof lane, acquiring local subjects and failure-owner contracts through cold start. Entry is sufficient only if it supports determining source coherence/drift refusal, execution containment, observation-to-action control, replay-visible yield, outer closure with absent inner proof and lawful agentic traversal with deterministic admission. Apply contract application; unanswered required relations prevent entry sufficiency, and generic packets/glossaries cannot supply the actual subject.

conditions: For operative framework realization.

grounding.quote: Operative framework behavior must be built outcome-first: outcome traversals first, declarative GTL/ABG carrier structure second, and minimal imperative adapter code last.

constraints.statement: Build outcome traversals first, declarative GTL/ABG structure second and minimal imperative adapters last. Preserve typed assets, named functions/catalog/module, ABG execution, the observation-to-action loop, history-derived projections, manually explainable automation, lawful yield and minimal-packet agentic walkthrough with deterministic admission.

conditions: Before publishing a review or handoff.
exceptions: A concise sufficient reference may carry the complete result record.

grounding.quote: commentary cannot supply an absent decision.

constraints.statement: Retain observations/claims' basis and distinguish evidence from authority. Apply Workspace and context to bound subject/basis and report judgments through complete core results. Posting location/conventions are guide choices. Provisional, investigative, comparative, argumentative or unratified material belongs in commentary; live requirements, live design decisions and active process law belong in applicable bound WHAT or ratified design surfaces, not posts.
constraints.uncertainty: Foundations F2/F6, context and complete result contracts are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS_CATEGORY_SUBJECT.md

constraints.statement: Default local-file naming uses YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS_CATEGORY_SUBJECT.md; 20260327T120000_REVIEW_bootloader-boundary.md is an example, not a required instance. Subject should be short, specific and stable for scanning. Non-file carriers must preserve equivalent stable identity, publication time, category, subject, author, discussion state and supersession history.

exceptions: Closed-post updates are discouraged, not absolutely prohibited; new posts are preferred for material conclusion changes, reopened disputes or new bounded subjects.

grounding.quote:
While a post is `Draft` or `Open`, update the same post when the change is
still part of the same bounded discussion.

constraints.statement: Status explicitly records discussion state. Draft/Open changes within the same bounded discussion update the same post, including corrections, replies, refined recommendations, repriced confidence and same-subject evidence. Preserve original Date as first publication time; add/update Updated when useful. Closed records remain commentary unless/until content is adopted into bound WHAT, ratified design or accepted implementation.

exceptions: Open posts may be revised in place; closed posts should normally be superseded.

grounding.quote:
1. State whether the post describes current reality, target direction, or both.
2. Separate findings from recommendations.
3. Use exact file or requirement references when making claims.
4. Do not present a post as if it were already ratified.

constraints.statement: State current reality, target direction or both; separate findings/recommendations; use exact file/requirement refs for claims; do not imply ratification; do not stealthily rewrite closed history; keep each post to one bounded subject.

grounding.quote: A post becomes consequential only when its content is explicitly adopted into:

constraints.statement: A post becomes consequential only through explicit content adoption into bound WHAT, ratified design or accepted implementation; until then it is commentary, not law.

conditions: For reusable shared-method change.
exceptions: Executable tool, runtime, carrier schema or assurance implementation needs separate Product authorization.

grounding.quote:
Other standards consume admitted law by reference, and
consumers select complete released versions rather than mixing members from
different cuts.

constraints.statement: Preserve the declared authority-causality chain without treating it as prescribed intake artifacts/workflow. Accompanying a lesson does not authorize executable or schema/assurance additions to STDO. Other standards reference admitted law, and consumers explicitly select complete released versions rather than mixed-cut members.

conditions: For domain instances of shared contracts.

grounding.quote:
Domain
instances bind their predicates, policies and grants; they do not copy a rival
generic law or acquire a new runtime API.

constraints.statement: Domain instances bind predicates, policies and grants to shared responsibilities without copying rival generic law or acquiring a new runtime API.
constraints.uncertainty: The index names ownership; full referenced contracts are not supplied.

conditions: When choosing task-relevant source acquisition.
exceptions: Independent-assessment shared conditions are acquired where the domain requires independence; a frame is acquired when its broader scope is material.

grounding.quote:
No view supplies universal task sufficiency or a
work, effect, admission or acceptance grant.

constraints.statement: Start from actual-question owners and bind selected Product, subject, outcome, evidence and existing grant; acquire material domain mapping/adopted profile. Routes: intake/re-entry→Spec intake/classification plus Ticket carrier admission when admitting work; recovery/uncertain effects→Foundations workspace then library recovery; evidence reuse after change→Foundations retention and contract currentness; outcome fitness→bounded construction/assertions/assurance provenance; result/combination→result algebra/conjunction and applicable domain refinement; candidate/disposition→Spec assessment/delegation/proportional disposition plus judgment/authority. Frames assemble excerpts: triage/carrier, recovery, evaluation/conjunction, member assessment, constitutional derivation, domain binding and release/adoption. Member assessment still needs actual Product requirements/acceptance. Views identify owner sections/digests; material coupled duties outside selection require source re-entry. Frame availability requires neither reading all frames nor grants/sufficiency.
constraints.uncertainty: Linked owner bodies and frame assemblies are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
The calculus is distinct from
interpreted a_c subject models and separately owned mechanical encodings.
Traversal adoption is optional and binds an exact signature and basis.

constraints.statement: Each member retains its applicability/scope and classification. Calculus/optional Traversal retain signatures; Baseline and derived profiles retain adoption/owning determinations. Generic frame law does not make actor profiles generic owners. Glossary resolves locators while located methods own meaning. Foundations/library supply premise/shared conditional contracts under Methodology Product authority; particular methods retain additional policies/grants. Calculus is distinct from a_c subject interpretations and mechanical encodings; optional Traversal adoption binds exact signature/basis.
constraints.uncertainty: The listed owners' full applicability, signatures and adoption contracts are outside this supplied index.

exceptions: A local copy is operative only when explicitly bound and verified; it is not the default.
Acquire the whole corpus only when material to the selected claim.

grounding.quote:
Reading this
source package for assessment neither changes an operative Product basis nor
establishes an installed release.

constraints.statement: Raw members retain semantic standing and deciding owners remain authoritative. Current sufficient projections convey duties without acquiring authority; stale/insufficient views require exact owners. Toolchain installs complete immutable cuts in shared versioned store and resolves logical release URIs without local machine paths in Product Definitions. Consumer basis requires exact cut, Product Definition basis URI, manifest digest and member inventory; mutable heads/selectors cannot replace them. Artifact presence grants no release/operation authority. Acquire sufficient responsibility frame, exact subject and material dependencies for one action; owner controls result, independence and disposition use. ODD continuation remains evaluate_next. Projected frames belong to the complete set with exact bytes/owners/fidelity and are not independent version selections. Material interpretation use follows its declared projection/re-entry contract; encodings/checkers supply only declared evidence while owners decide meaning.
constraints.uncertainty: Distribution, interpretation and schema implementations are not supplied.

conditions: Applies to human, agentic, deterministic, probabilistic, assurance and mixed work where governing Product/method permits it.

grounding.quote: This is an engagement meta-method.

constraints.statement: The method governs bounded contexts over changing work, owning frame declaration, activation, evaluation, basis, relation, result, coverage, revision and qualification in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation under exact publication basis. It consumes shared results, conjunction and workspace/context, with finer results as refinements and library relations imposing no execution sequence. Given task, dependencies and capable actor, acquisition must be sufficiently bounded rather than globally assumed; partition/protocol/actor arrangement remains declared choice. It defines no application profile, role mapping, Product frame binding, domain Product, taxonomy, ontology, runtime, workflow, adoption relation or assurance implementation. External specialization retains external authority and does not amend principles. Nominal proximity does not import profile/Product/role/runtime identities.

grounding.quote:
Unknown and out-of-frame results are lawful pressure for reconfiguration.
   They are not failed evaluations or implied acceptance.

constraints.statement: No finite actor is presumed to attend the whole workspace. A useful frame is finite and sufficient for its family; evaluations determine material attention. Human authority may select practical sets from experience without mechanically unique partitions. Frames may overlap, compose, refine, restrict, translate or succeed; hierarchy is optional and joint use need not compose coordinates. Coverage is relative to workspace, outcome, inventory, basis and time. Selection/result use apply authority conservation. Unknown/out-of-frame results press reconfiguration without implying failed evaluation or acceptance. Historical failures/resets/invisible violations inform declaration, activation, actor or set improvement.

grounding.quote:
Observed state can defeat a stale summary; the summary cannot change the state.
External effects require observations from their owning surfaces.

A moving basis must declare how advancement
is detected and when reevaluation is required.

constraints.statement: Observed state may defeat stale summaries; summaries cannot change material state. Observe external effects at owning surfaces. Moving bases must declare advancement detection and reevaluation conditions.

conditions: When relying on evidence.

grounding.quote:
A sufficiently small frame or an authenticated observation alone
does not establish a sound, complete decision on its predicate.

constraints.statement: Bind Construction assurance to the predicate, observations and consuming decision, retaining assertion and execution provenance distinctions. Small context or authentication alone does not prove decision soundness/completeness.
constraints.uncertainty: Construction assurance is referenced but not supplied.

exceptions: Human authority may use an explicitly admitted bounded proxy where governing identity/authority law permits; proxy and human identities stay distinct.

grounding.quote:
A read-only evaluation declares no operation authority. An effectful
evaluation names the existing owner-issued operation grant it applies.

Actor
capability may justify a different frame size or activation sequence. It cannot
waive an invariant or widen authority.

constraints.statement: Apply authority separation/conservation to declaration, selection, activation and execution. Read-only evaluation declares no operation grant; effectful evaluation names its existing grant. Capability may justify another frame size/sequence but never waive invariants or enlarge authority.

exceptions: Binding may be expressed wholly in source-linked prose.

grounding.quote:
The binding may be expressed entirely in source-linked prose; representation
cannot create, widen, or replace it.

constraints.statement: Every material tuple coordinate must resolve to exact source, subject, basis, authority, evidence route, actor envelope, result relation and invalidation condition. Representation cannot create, replace or enlarge this binding.

conditions: Each law-family row presupposes a declared evaluation and its named material relations.

grounding.quote:
neither the evaluation nor its authority is
derived from a resource limit.

constraints.statement: F1–F6 standing remains with Foundations; frame policies are additional owner choices. Task owner selects question, frame owner family/tuple. Frame-set authority selects actor/partition; execution binding selects its envelope, not universal byte limits. Subject owners define equality; frames invalidators; domain rechart/observation mechanisms; existing owners grants; translation owner mapping/loss. Configuration, communication and authority are not one hierarchy or unique optimum. Closed-result conjunction does not require merged manifolds; coordinate/operation joins need their contract. Refused admission cannot invent downstream evaluation or erase supported counterevidence; lost returns retain supported performance/effects. Compression must preserve material permissions, failures and uncertainty, including useful independent/capability overlap. Required predicates come from owners, not received returns; inventory/exclusions from declared authority. One successful activation does not qualify all families/actors/changed frames; diagnose failed relation before adding a frame and retain unknown coverage.
constraints.uncertainty: This overview references owner contracts and later qualification/coverage criteria not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
Every frame declares the evaluation family it supports. A frame with no
declared evaluation family has no testable sufficiency boundary.

constraints.statement: Activation establishes actual-question membership in the declared family. Availability in a set or similar task name does not establish membership. An outside question needs a suitable frame or applicable scoped result; renaming cannot preserve the original obligation.

grounding.quote:
An activated frame contains a finite attention surface that fits the selected
actor's declared capability envelope.

constraints.statement: Activated attention must fit the selected envelope. Undeclared ambient memory, conversation history or effectively global context makes activation unreconstructable for that actor.

conditions: For the declared evaluation family Q.
exceptions: No proof of absence of all undiscovered material relations is required.

grounding.quote: An omitted material relation makes the activation insufficient.

constraints.statement: Contract-application Support requires all known material relations in M or a declared authoritative input. Omitting any such relation makes activation insufficient.
constraints.uncertainty: The known-relation boundary does not settle undiscovered relations.

conditions: When relations are established irrelevant to Q.
exceptions: Retain material needed to establish irrelevance.

grounding.quote:
exclude relations established irrelevant to that evaluation,
retaining any material needed to establish irrelevance.

constraints.statement: Apply Workspace and context to exclude established-irrelevant relations from Q's attention. Adjacent material's mere existence does not expand the frame.

conditions: For every result and proposed reuse.
exceptions: A basis advance alone does not invalidate a historical result.
Other admissible evidence may decide a predicate despite stale supporting evidence.

grounding.quote:
Stale supporting
evidence under an interpretable governing basis instead follows
[RF-012](#rf-012-closed-results): insufficient support leaves the predicate
`indeterminate` unless other admissible evidence decides it.
